nd714c9e748.summary: Nigeria's Finance Minister Zainab Ahmed inaugurated a steering committee for the 'Project Lighthouse' initiative aimed at enhancing tax-related intelligence.
nd714c9e748.why: Improving tax intelligence and collection is vital for Nigeria's fiscal health and funding of public services, impacting economic stability and investor confidence.

n24a7893f67.summary: Godwin Emefiele, Governor of Nigeria's Central Bank, stated that policies will continue to reduce Nigeria's reliance on imported items.
n24a7893f67.why: Reducing import dependence aims to boost local production and improve Nigeria's trade balance and economic resilience.

nef3eb5a1cc.headline: China: Warning to speculators over the yuan
nef3eb5a1cc.summary: A spokesperson for the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission said he does not expect the yuan's decline to last. He warned speculative investors against bets on further weakness.
nef3eb5a1cc.why: The yuan is China's currency, and official signals from regulators often influence speculative positioning and offshore exchange rate expectations.
